title: short-video-builder clips.json
description: The spec the model writes: which excerpts of one landscape talk become 9:16 shorts, with the hook, the reason and the style. scripts/clipspec.py validates it against this schema (stdlib subset of shared/scripts/validate_json.py), then checks it against the transcript. There is deliberately no intro or title card field: a short opens on the speaker's first words.

source.description: The landscape video, relative to this file or absolute.

transcript.description: words.json written by transcribe.py and signed by proofread.py.

objective.description: What the clips are for; shapes the choice of excerpts.

speaker.description: Optional lower third over the first seconds of every clip.

time.description: Seconds (12.5) or M:SS.s on the source timeline.

hook.description: The first sentence the speaker says in the clip, verbatim from the proofread transcript.

reason.description: Why this excerpt, for this objective: what a stranger gets from it with no context.

title.description: Post title or first line of the caption (copy, goes through the writing gate).

post.description: Optional post caption (copy, goes through the writing gate).

x.description: fixed: horizontal centre of the crop as a fraction of the source width. track: the person to follow when several faces are visible.

cta.description: Optional end card. It dissolves in after the last word while the source keeps playing under it, never a silent frozen card.

brand_json.description: project-context/brand.json; its colors.accent, colors.bg, colors.text and fonts.body.family fill the fields left empty here.

accent.description: Active-word colour, progress bar, CTA link.

font.description: Fontconfig family installed on the machine.

logo.description: PNG with transparency, shown top right. SVG is not read: export a PNG.
